services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Experience a sunset aboard a classic Yacht! 2 Hours About the Tahoe Bleu Wave Yacht This beautiful 1966 Million Dollar Classic Yacht has been around the world and now cruises Lake Tahoe's pristine waters. The Tahoe Bleu Wave is an exceptional tour boat measuring in at over 70 feet long with capacity for up to 47 people. Luxuriously comfortable amenities include a fully stocked bar with fireplace, private lounge, stateroom, fly-bridge, gigantic party bow, restrooms and full climate controlled indoor facilities. More Info We service ALL OF TAHOE - North, South, East & West!!! Included For all ages! • Great for couples! • 2 Hours

services.name: 4th of July Sunset Dinner and Fireworks Cruise
services.desc: . Join us for a fun evening on the lake! We will cruise over to Lake Tahoe's beautiful Emerald Bay to catch the Sunset. After Emerald Bay we will go over to the Nevada side of the lake, where we will get up close to Lake Tahoe's spectacular 4th of July Fireworks show over the lake. Tickets will include a full dinner, 1 complimentary Beer, Wine or Champagne, all non alcoholic drinks and a champagne toast for the firework show! services.name: Emerald Bay Sightseeing Cruise
services.desc: Cruise the most visited area in all of Tahoe and one of the most photographed areas in the world!!! 2 Hours About This popular afternoon cruise takes a tour across 6 miles of crystal clear water from South Lake Tahoe into Emerald Bay. You will be surrounded by the majestic mountains of Lake Tahoe. As you cruise you will find indoor and outdoor seating available all with 360 degree panoramic views of Lake Tahoe, the snow-capped mountains, Fannette Island, Vikingsholm Castle, Eagle Waterfall and the Rubicon. Our captains will give our guests a personal narration of the incredible facts 2 Hours • For all ages! • Great for couples! • Beautiful scenery!
